_readme: Held-out coverage of predictive intervals. Every interval is fitted on the outer training fold only (inner grouped CV); the outer test fold is never used to calibrate. Same outer folds as metrics_v2. Coverage = share of held-out predictions inside the interval; width in eV.

exchangeability.gkf: holds: shuffled grouped KFold, test formulas a random subset
exchangeability.loo: approximately holds: each formula left out once

guarantee: CV+ / jackknife+: marginal coverage >= 1 - 2 alpha under exchangeability (Barber et al., Ann. Stat. 2021). No guarantee on lobo/loao; conditional (per-compound) coverage is never guaranteed.

k2.rule: PASS iff the best model's lobo MAE is >= 30% below the reference baseline AND the paired 95 % CI of the MAE difference excludes 0. Design wording: reference = mean baseline. Stricter: reference = best baseline.

methods.gpr_physics9_cvplus: CV+ around gpr_physics9 (MAPIE CrossConformalRegressor, GroupKFold(5) inner)
methods.gpr_sigma_scaled: GPR mu +/- z*c*sigma, c = RMS inner-CV standardised residual (training fold only)
methods.mean_cvplus: CV+ around mean (MAPIE CrossConformalRegressor, GroupKFold(5) inner)
methods.ridge_physics9_cvplus: CV+ around ridge_physics9 (MAPIE CrossConformalRegressor, GroupKFold(5) inner)
